IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark
hair blowing slightly across her shoulder
stands outdoors against a bright blue
sky. She wears a black high-neck
long-sleeve lace top with a ruffled hem
and a silver chain necklace. Dark cargo
trousers and a black strap complete the
look. Her expression is calm and
serious, with a direct gaze. Warm,
natural sunlight with a soft blurred
background. Palette of black, sky blue,
and warm skin tones. Candid and
grunge-inspired, in the style of a film
photo.
